skill.name: standup-meeting
skill.description: Conduct effective daily standup meetings for agile teams. Use when facilitating standups, tracking blockers, or improving team synchronization. Handles standup format, time management, and blocker resolution.
skill.summary: Facilitate focused daily standups, blocker tracking, and agile team synchronization.
skill.author: supercent-io

content.value_statement: Teams lose focus when standups become long status meetings. This skill structures updates, blockers, action items, and async check-ins.
actual_capabilities: Provides a three-question daily standup template.
Supports board-based standups organized by work status.
Creates async standup updates for remote teams.
Formats standup minutes with attendees, blockers, and action items.
Separates deep problem solving into follow-up discussions.
limitations: Does not integrate directly with Jira, Slack, or calendar tools.
Does not verify team member availability or attendance.
Does not resolve blockers without human follow-up.
Requires accurate sprint and task details from the user.

use_cases.title: Facilitate a Daily Scrum
use_cases.description: Run a short meeting that captures yesterday's work, today's plan, and current blockers.

use_cases.title: Coordinate Remote Updates
use_cases.description: Create a concise async standup format for distributed team members in different time zones.

use_cases.title: Track Sprint Blockers
use_cases.description: Summarize blocked work, assign owners, and record follow-up action items after the standup.

prompt_templates.title: Start a Basic Standup
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner facilitation for a small team.
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me run today's daily standup for a five-person agile team. Use the three-question format and capture action items.

prompt_templates.title: Create an Async Update
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an async standup template for my remote team. Include yesterday, today, blockers, and sprint progress.

prompt_templates.title: Walk the Sprint Board
prompt_templates.prompt: Facilitate a board-based standup using these columns: In Progress, Blocked, Ready for Review, and Done. Summarize risks and owners.

prompt_templates.title: Produce Standup Minutes
prompt_templates.prompt: Turn these standup notes into minutes with a summary, individual updates, blockers, decisions, and prioritized action items.

output_examples.input: Run a standup for a team working on authentication, profile pages, and database migration.
output_examples.output: A concise standup agenda with each member's yesterday, today, and blockers sections, plus action items for access and documentation.

output_examples.input: Summarize a standup where one story is blocked by production database access.
output_examples.output: A meeting summary that lists sprint progress, the blocked database migration, the owner, the expected resolution time, and follow-up tasks.

output_examples.input: Create an async update format for a remote team.
output_examples.output: A chat-ready daily update template with sections for completed work, planned work, blockers, and current sprint progress.

best_practices: Keep the meeting time-boxed to 15 minutes.
Move detailed problem solving to a separate follow-up discussion.
Record blocker owners and due times before the meeting ends.
anti_patterns: Turning the standup into a manager status report.
Letting technical debates consume the meeting.
Ending without owners for urgent blockers.

faq.question: What meeting format does this skill support?
faq.answer: It supports three-question standups, board-based standups, async updates, and standup minutes.

faq.question: Can it help with remote teams?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes an async update format that works well for distributed teams.

faq.question: Does it connect to project management tools?
faq.answer: No. Users must provide task, sprint, and blocker details manually.

faq.question: How does it handle blockers?
faq.answer: It captures each blocker, assigns an owner, and records a follow-up action.

faq.question: Is this only for Scrum teams?
faq.answer: No. Scrum teams fit best, but any agile team can use the templates.

faq.question: Can Claude, Codex, or Claude Code use it?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
